items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Then I got into Kit Howard's band. He'd take me into his band in his orchestra.

ctx.x: Well, what other traps did he have? I don't know.

Well, he had a tambourine. He used to have one hooked on the side of it. He was driving. He had this side cymbal and a little ball on it. Connected to his ball that hit the bass drum and this little thing would hit that cymbal. Well, that answer for us like they got sock cymbals today. Mm-hmm. That was asking for a sock cymbal thing. During those days. They didn't use sock cymbals. Then when the free sock cymbal come out, they had a little small sock cymbal that's weighed on. They didn't play with the sticks all…
